question: How do the phases of breath relate to the seizing of time?
premises: With inhalations and retentions the power holds and seizes time.
With exhalation it completely seizes all time.
Risen with exhalation, it acts in an instant.
inference: The breath phases progressively master time, culminating in instantaneous total seizure through exhalation.
uncertainties: The subject of grasate/saṃgrasate is carried from the preceding context (the power).
plain_english: Through inhalations and retentions it holds and seizes time, but through exhalation it completely seizes all time; rising with the exhalation, it does so in an instant.
